title: User Manifest (Tier-2 slim)
description: Identity/config manifest for a brain-stem Tier-2 GA install. Instance file: user-manifest.json. Carries the fields the onboarding interview captures (the substitution inputs for the two CLAUDE.md templates plus runtime path/identity fields) plus the runtime hook-threshold extensions. Read-side consumers (hooks/session-start.sh, hooks/prompt-context.sh, lib/paths.sh, skills/librarian/lib/user-manifest-read.sh, install.sh identity substitution) all read with jq '<path> // default' — fields dropped from this slim contract degrade to the consumer's own default; no Tier-2-live consumer validates an instance against this schema. The only write-side validator is onboarding/bootstrap-user-manifest.sh. The `hooks` block is the extension surface (hooks.memory_review thresholds + hooks.context_pressure thresholds).

name.description: Fills {{IDENTITY_NAME}} in both CLAUDE.md templates. Confirmed from `git config --global user.name` in Section A.

email.description: Runtime/identity field. Confirmed from `git config --global user.email` in Section A. Not a template placeholder.

role.description: Fills {{IDENTITY_ROLE}} in the claude-home template. Consolidated from the Section B transcript by the slim extraction pass.

organization.description: Fills {{IDENTITY_ORGANIZATION}} in the claude-home template. Consolidated from Section B; null when the user is independent or leaves it unstated.

paths.description: Filesystem pointers. paths.vault_root is canonical; vault.root mirrors it. additionalProperties:true — paths.sh reads every field with `jq // default`, so an override degrades gracefully to the install-convention default; the block stays open so a future path knob never trips bootstrap validation (the reject-what-the-reader-supports class).

vault_root.description: Fills {{VAULT_ROOT}} in the vault template. Null = no-vault stub (the brain vault is built inline when vault.is_fresh).

plans_root.description: Fills {{PLANS_HOME}} in the vault template. Install resolves to ~/.claude-plans when null.

state_root.description: Override for $CLAUDE_STATE_ROOT — the machine-local ephemeral state root (per-session checkpoint/pressure + the coordination dir); default ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-~/.local/state}/brain-stem. Read by hooks/lib/paths.sh.

hooks_state.description: Override for $HOOKS_STATE — the hooks runtime state dir; default $CLAUDE_STATE_ROOT/hooks-state. Read by hooks/lib/paths.sh.

log_dir.description: Override for $CLAUDE_LOG_DIR — the cron + orchestrator run-log dir; default $CLAUDE_STATE_ROOT/logs (the XDG state log tier). Read by hooks/lib/paths.sh.

backups_dir.description: Override for $BACKUPS_DIR; default ~/Backups. Read by hooks/lib/paths.sh and the librarian backup capability.

vault.description: Tier-2 builds a FRESH 'brain' vault inline at install — so there is no is_fresh branch. User cluster folders and vault-specific rules are NOT captured in the interview: clusters are created organically via the runtime propose-and-validate folder flow, and rules are hand-edited into the vault CLAUDE.md's <USER> section. additionalProperties:true — the librarian capabilities below read these via skills/librarian/lib/user-manifest-read.sh (umr_get_*) with graceful defaults; the block stays open so a new vault-customization knob never trips bootstrap validation (the reject-what-the-reader-supports class).

root.description: Mirror of paths.vault_root (kept for read-API parity).

top_level_folder.description: Fills {{VAULT_TOP_LEVEL_FOLDER}} in the vault template. NOT interview-captured in Tier-2 (clusters are deferred to the runtime folder flow). Set to the brain vault's starter cluster at build time, or substitutes a default; null until then.

tag_audit_exemptions.description: User-extension tag-audit exemption patterns. Read by skills/librarian/capabilities/tag-coverage-audit.sh (umr_get_array).

projects_root_dirname.description: Vault projects-root dir name override. Read by frontmatter-enforce.sh (umr_get_string).

people_dirname.description: Vault people dir name override. Read by frontmatter-enforce.sh (umr_get_string).

projects_subdirname.description: Vault projects-subdir name override. Read by frontmatter-enforce.sh (umr_get_string).

strategic_dirname.description: Vault strategic-cluster dir name override. Read by frontmatter-enforce.sh (umr_get_string).

planning_dirname.description: Vault planning dir name override. Read by frontmatter-enforce.sh (umr_get_string).

behavioral.description: Personal-prose fields, each distilled by the slim extraction pass from the Section B transcript into <=4 tight lines sized for the claude-home template's 60-line cap. Optional; a field is null when the user skipped that prose prompt. additionalProperties:true — runtime hook-preference toggles below are read with graceful defaults; the block stays open so a new toggle never trips bootstrap validation (the reject-what-the-reader-supports class).

communication_style.description: Fills the claude-home template '## Communication Style' USER section.

working_patterns.description: Fills the claude-home template '## Working Patterns' USER section.

tooling_domain.description: Fills the claude-home template '## Tooling & Domain' USER section.

memory_consolidation_enabled.description: Opt-out for the SessionEnd memory-consolidation gate. Default = enabled; set false to skip (writes a '## Skipped' audit line). Read by hooks/memory-consolidation-check.sh + memory-consolidation-run.sh.

writers_health_check.description: Dormant-until-opt-in activation for the daily writers-health-audit cron dispatch (installer/cron-dispatch.sh). Tri-state: absent/'unset' = dormant, never proposed; 'enabled' = the daily health check is scheduled (default-on for all subsequent writers once accepted); 'declined' = dormant + re-proposable at a later writer registration. The propose-and-confirm at first-writer registration (skills/govern/modes/writer.sh mode_commit) sets it. Read with `jq // "unset"`.

governance_parity_audit.description: Dormant-until-opt-in activation for the weekly governance-parity-audit cron dispatch (installer/cron-dispatch.sh). Its 6 governance-PILLAR inputs are build-dogfood-only, so the weekly dispatch is DORMANT on an adopter install unless this key is 'enabled'. Tri-state: absent/'unset' = dormant, never proposed; 'enabled' = scheduled weekly; 'declined' = dormant + re-proposable. MANUAL opt-in — governance-parity-audit is NOT writer-triggered and has no auto-propose lifecycle event (unlike writers_health_check); the adopter opts in by SETTING THIS KEY BY HAND. Read with `jq // "unset"`.

hooks.description: Runtime hook-threshold overrides. extension surface. All fields optional; consumers read with jq '<path> // default' and fall back to the documented defaults when absent.

memory_review.description: Memory-review surfacing thresholds + opt-out. Consumed by memory-review-banner.sh (SessionStart), prompt-context.sh (re-firing band), stop-checkpoint-check.sh (high-severity CONFLICT Stop-block yielding to R-26).

enabled.description: Opt-out toggle. Default = true (memory-review surfaces). Set false to silence the banner + mandate + Stop-block. Default behavior is opt-out, not opt-in.

high_severity_pending_days.description: Days a high-severity item may be pending before the re-firing mandate escalates. Default 3. Resolved env > manifest > default in review-queue.sh (_rq_high_sev_days).

defer_count_cap.description: defer_count at which an item force-escalates to the re-firing mandate. Default 2. Resolved env > manifest > default in review-queue.sh (_rq_defer_cap).

context_pressure.description: R-26 context-pressure loop thresholds. ONLY warn_pct + mandate_pct are consumed (by prompt-context.sh's warn/mandate bands). The stop-gate's 48/80/90 boundaries are FIXED constants in stop-checkpoint-check.sh by design — a safety gate is not weakened by misconfig (sessions.md: 'the stop-gate reads neither field') — so hard_pct is schema-parity vocabulary only and is NOT consumed by any hook.

warn_pct.description: At-next-boundary warn threshold, as a percentage of the TRUE model context window (the .pct writer resolves the window per model family — Haiku 200k, the 1M fleet 1,000,000). Default 45. Consumed by prompt-context.sh.

mandate_pct.description: Immediate-action mandate threshold, as a percentage of the TRUE model context window (Haiku 200k, the 1M fleet 1,000,000). Default 48. Consumed by prompt-context.sh.

hard_pct.description: Schema-parity vocabulary ONLY — NOT consumed. The stop-gate's 80-90% existence-gate boundary (and the 48%/90% bounds) are fixed constants in stop-checkpoint-check.sh by design, not manifest-driven (sessions.md 'not read from your settings'). The 80 documents the in-code constant for readers.

system.description: Writer-owned system fields + runtime system knobs. additionalProperties:true — backup_targets is read by the librarian backup capability with a graceful default; the block stays open so a new system knob never trips bootstrap validation (the reject-what-the-reader-supports class).

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York), needed for TZ-aware hooks. Confirmed from `readlink /etc/localtime` in Section A.

backup_targets.description: Extra directories the librarian backup capability snapshots beyond the defaults. Read by skills/librarian/capabilities/backup.sh.

created_date.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the manifest was written by bootstrap-user-manifest.sh.

onboarding_complete.description: true once the slim interview has produced this manifest. hooks/session-start.sh reads this flag for the onboarding-resume detect.
